notes.note: McGrath was great with his 19 disposals and had the third best score for the Bombers.
McGrath suffered a broken jaw and will now be missing for some time.
First ton of the year for McGrath. 5 tackles and a goal were the key contributors along with 19 disposals.
The new skipper is someone we have always looked at and often passed over.  His score was in the range we have come to accept from him.
